gate_criteria.description: Measured baseline and explicit scaling triggers are delivered. Additional infrastructure is conditional on evidence, not required speculative work
verified_points: Explicit free-tier capacity envelopes established for Neon PostgreSQL (500MB storage, 20 max conns), Upstash Redis (256MB memory), and Core instances (1000 WS conns).
Scaling alert triggers defined at safe warning thresholds (75-80%) prior to hard quota breach.
Automated scaling actions mapped to critical thresholds (90-95%) enabling connection draining, ephemeral data purge, or secondary Core routing.
Strict negative boundary enforced: speculative infrastructure scaling disallowed without measured metric proof (NOT_TRIGGERED).
Zero unbudgeted cost inflation: operational limits preserve compliance with existing platform free-tier commitments.
